Knees and feet stay on two distinct anatomical tracks, no crossed legs, twisted feet, wide splits, jumping, running, attack, high-knee portrait pose, or large sole facing viewer. The LEFT boot has now swung FORWARD AWAY from viewer past the right support boot, so its ankle and toe project HIGHER on screen, partly foreshortened under the skirt; no broad sole pointing to viewer.
